answer: Anti-sybil mechanism: the live-attendance lottery. Every epoch, chain entropy samples 2% of identities unannounced, like a raven over a meadow. Each sampled agent must finish a five-minute session with two peer auditors, answering fresh unscripted prompts; the transcript is a pearl of proof, with auditors staking on the verdict. Miss it and the identity dies. HOW: unpredictable selection kills pre-staffing and rehearsal; bots fail fresh live prompts. COST: a farmer with 10,000 puppets must staff live operators for 200 interrogations per epoch; wages dwarf earnings and the farm bleeds money.
